contents.text: Basically completely revamped Hydration system which now accomodates for sprinting, jumping etc. and is also accessable for future updates
Added Machinery! There are now custom "blocks" in the game which can all be crafted in the crafting table
Recipes will now be earned throughout the game instead of hardcoded or only after crafting (not all, but many)
Added the Mineral Analyser and decided the first blocks which can be analysed, including those pesky -ites. Rewards, including custom items,

contents: and some otherwise unobtainable or difficult vanilla stuff, will be expanded in the future

contents.text: Added heating and cooling units! These ugly little custom blocks act like a mini-beacon, influencing the temperature around. They need to be fueled though ... urgh, can't a single thing be easy in this pack?
Frogspawn and moss are now obtainable through the analyser and also two custom items, for now without use
